card.name: Hanako-kun, Toilet Bound
card.text: Partner with Yashiro Nene, Ghost Bound. Flying Whenever a creature leaves the battlefield, if it wasn't put into a graveyard, draw a card. This ability triggers once each turn.

card.name: Minamoto Teru
card.text: Haste, Protection from Spirits Instant and sorcery spells you control have lifelink, deathtouch and can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponent's control unless they pay 2 life.

card.name: Kou, Young Exorcist
card.text: Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.) If a noncombat source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, you may have it deal damage equal to Kou's power instead. If you do, Kou deals that much damage to himself.

card.name: Mitsuba, Mystery No3
card.text: Flying, Ward—Discard a card Whenever an opponent discards a permanent card, create a copy of that card, except it has "Whenever this becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it" and is an Illusion in addition to its other types.

card.name: Tsukasa, Hanako's Yorishiro
card.text: Deathtouch Whenever an attacking creature dies, Tsukasa deals 1 damage to each opponent. At the beginning of each opponent's combat step, that player chooses an opponent other than you at random. Creatures they control attack that player this turn if able.

card.name: Stitch Together
card.text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Threshold — Return that card from your graveyard to the battlefield instead if seven or more cards are in your graveyard.

card.name: Tsuchigomori, Mystery No.5
card.text: Delve (Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for {1}.) Trample Whenever Tsuchigomori deals combat damage to an opponent, choose a card exiled with it at random and put it in your hand. Then if there's no cards exiled with him, put a +1/+1 on him.

card.name: Nanamine Sakura
card.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have three or more different types of counters among permanents you control, create a 2/1 black Insect creature token with flying. {T}, Sacrifice another creature: Gain control of target creature with three or more counters. If that creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead.

card.name: Akane Aoi, Rumor Whisperer
card.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1. Then, choose land or nonland. Target opponent guesses whether the top card of your library is a land or a nonland card. If they were wrong, you may put that card onto the battlefield under your control. If they were right, mill a card and return Aoi to your hand.

card.name: Kako, Mystery No.1
card.text: When Kako enters, create Mirai, a legendary 1/1 blue Spirit artifact creature token with phasing and hexproof. (It phases in or out before you untap during each of your untap steps. While it's phased out, it's treated as though it doesn't exist.) Whenever another permanent you control phases in, put a time counter on Kako. Then if he has 6 or more time counters on him, remove all time counters from Kako and take an extra turn after this one.

card.name: Shijima Mei, Mystery No.4
card.text: When Shijima Mei, Mystery No.4 enters, you may discard a card. If you do, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until the end of your next turn. Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a tapped Treasure token.

card.name: Yako, Mystery No.2
card.text: Trample, Soulbond (You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.) When a creature paired with Yako leaves the battlefield, put three +1/+1 counters on Yako. She gains "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to any other target."

card.name: Shinigami, Mystery No.6
card.text: Menace Cards in graveyards can't be the target of spells and abilities opponents control and can't be exiled. Shinigami, Mystery No.6 can't attack or block unless a creature died this turn.

card.name: Akane Sumire, Pit's Offering
card.text: Vigilance As Akane Sumire enters, choose another creature you control. Whenever the chosen creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you don't control, change the target to Akane Sumire and you draw a card.

card.name: Secret Rendezvous
card.text: You and target opponent each draw three cards.

card.name: Yugi Amane
card.text: Deathtouch When Yugi Amane enters, if you don't control a Tentacle, create a 2/1 black Tentacle Horror creature token. During your turn, you may cast Yugi Amane from your graveyard by sacrificing a Spirit or Horror in addition to its other costs.

card.name: Temporal Tresspass
card.text: Delve (Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for {1}.) Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Temporal Tresspass

card.name: Natsuhiko, Spirit's Venom
card.text: Wither (This deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.) Ward—Pay 2 life. Whenever an opponent looses life for the first time during their turn, put that many -1/-1 counters on target creature that player controls.

card.name: Yashiro Nene, Ghost Bound
card.text: Partner with Hanako-kun, Toilet Bound. Whenever Yashiro Nene, Ghost Bound enters or becomes tapped, exile another target permanent. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next upkeep.

card.name: Aoi Akane, Presentkeeper
card.text: Flash If a player would take an extra turn, they skip that turn instead and lose 5 life. Players can't cast spells or activate abilities during other player's turn turn.

card.name: Mirai TBHK
card.text: Phasing, hexproof (This phases in or out before you untap during each of your untap steps. While it's phased out, it's treated as though it doesn't exist.)

card.name: Tiara, Rising Lightning
card.text: Haste Whenever Tiara, Rising Lightning attacks, you may exert her. If you do, exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Until end of turn, you may cast a copy of that card. (An exerted permanent won't untap during your next untap step.)
